summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Folios
summary.text: Catalog of astrological questions and their folio references, covering rumor, success, sedition and civil war, death, rank and glory, action, childbearing, accidents, foreign death, war, possessions, inheritances, conception, and the querent’s aim. The entries cite Saturn, Mars, the Sun, the ascendant, the midheaven, the lot of fortune, houses, signs, and benefics.
